updates.description: Clear delineation sponsor (subject matter) roles and accountabilities, based on the minimum requirement that sponsors / subject matter are responsible for specification and certification (1.4, 1.5, 3.1, 4.4)
strategic priorities: Accountabilities and roles and responsibilities related to data acquisition are defined based on function and are understood across the organization
updates.justification: The update explicitly states that subject matter is responsible for 'certification' in this sub-process.

updates.description: Full transfer of accountabilities for activities and functions related to data acquisition and collection to suppliers
strategic priorities: Accountabilities and roles and responsibilities related to data acquisition are defined based on function and are understood across the organization
updates.justification: Finalizing data collection and loading collected data, when done by suppliers, is part of this sub-process.

updates.description: Creation of a “trusted environment” which allows for the ingestion and processing of “risky” data through the use of confidential computing and other emerging technologies
strategic priorities: Confidentiality and privacy of data are ensured in the face of increasingly sensitive data holdings and new techniques for data integration and dissemination.
updates.justification: The ingestion of 'risky' data requires specific loading procedures and security considerations when finalizing collection, which this environment would address.

updates.description: Elimination of duplicative data holdings by ensuring that data ingested and processed in the “trusted environment” becomes the master copy of the data (4.4)
strategic priorities: Data infrastructure is modernized to support the more efficient acquisition, processing and delivery of data and statistical products.
updates.justification: The update explicitly references GSBPM step 4.4, indicating that once data is ingested and processed in the trusted environment, it becomes the master copy at the finalisation of collection.
